content:
As Liquid Glass redesign officially rolls out to most iOS WhatsApp users, the messaging platform is now testing another visual change, this time focusing on the appearance of chat bubbles. Details below.

New chat bubble design is more rounded

Months ago, WhatsApp finally rolled out the Liquid Glass redesign more widely, after months of testing and refining the new design with select users via TestFlight.

Around the same time, WABetaInfo spotted references in the app's code pointing to a redesign of WhatsApp chat bubbles. The site now reports that the new bubble design is beginning to roll out to select users running the latest TestFlight version.

Here's what WABetaInfo reported:

In addition to redesigning the shape of message bubbles, the new design also changes the way media and links appear in conversations. WhatsApp has removed the green border around them, making photos, videos, animated images, and link previews look cleaner and more integrated.

According to WABetaInfo, the new look is currently available to select users running the WhatsApp TestFlight version. No timeline has been announced yet for a wider rollout to all iOS users.
